easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than the one you wish to donate.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief triggers.
In response, Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Surrak.
Resolve the Puca's Mischief trigger, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Surrak.
Activate the ability granted to Surrak by Martyrdom an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Surrak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
